description: The Water Security Toolkit combines distribution-network simulation, contamination-impact analysis and optimisation for sensor placement and response planning. EPA and research partners developed it during 2011-2018. This resource is provided by USEPA (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: BSD-3-Clause; dependencies have separate licences. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The repository is archived and deprecated, with an explicit warning against production use. Preserve its historical status and link to WNTR as the development successor. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
